claims.subject: Joint Movement Extension
claims.evidence_quote: In this paper, we formalize and extend the joint movement extension proposed by Feldmann et al. ( 2022).

claims.subject: Meta-modules
claims.evidence_quote: For that, we define meta-modules of rhombical and hexagonal shape.

claims.subject: Meta-modules
claims.evidence_quote: We show that these meta-modules are able to perform various movement primitives of other MRSs, e.g., crystalline atoms, and rectangular/hexagonal metamorphic robots.

claims.subject: Amoebot Structure
claims.evidence_quote: We present three amoebot structures that are able to move by rolling, crawling, and walking, respectively.

claims.subject: Modular Robotic Systems
